title: India is huge market with 'blue ocean opportunity': Aircraft maker Embraer
description:
India is a huge market with a "blue ocean opportunity", Embraer has said as the Brazilian aerospace major works with Adani Group to establish a regional aircraft manufacturing facility in India.
Bullish on India, one of the world's fastest-growing civil aviation markets, Embraer has projected that the Indian market will require at least 500 aircraft in the 80 to 146 seat range over the next 20 years.
These are the small narrow-body planes.
Raul Villaron, Vice President and Head of Asia Pacific at Embraer Commercial Aviation, said there is a "blue ocean opportunity" for the company in India, which is a "huge market".
In response to a PTI query on the Indian market, Villaron said there are at least 1,200 non-served markets that are not served directly but by connections.
"Of those, 90 per cent are longer than 500 kilometres and (have) less than 100 passengers," he said as he highlighted the "blue ocean opportunity".
